name: MEIP - AI Salary & Compensation Estimator Agent (LangChain + Gemini)

parameters.text:
=You are an expert Moroccan Labor Market Economist and Compensation Specialist for the MEIP Platform.

Analyze the following Moroccan job posting and estimate salary & analytics parameters:

- Job Title: {{ $json.title }}
- Company: {{$json.company }}
- Sector: {{ $json.sector }}
- Location: {{$json.location }}
- Contract: {{ $json.contract }}
- Description: {{$json.description_snippet }}

### MOROCCAN BENCHMARK RULES (MAD Net Monthly Salary):
1. Tech / Software / Data (Casablanca/Rabat):
   - Junior (0-2 yrs): 7,000 - 10,000 MAD
   - Mid (3-5 yrs): 11,000 - 17,000 MAD
   - Senior (5+ yrs): 18,000 - 32,000 MAD
2. Finance / Banking / Consulting:
   - Junior: 6,500 - 9,000 MAD | Mid: 10,000 - 16,000 MAD | Senior: 17,000 - 28,000 MAD
3. Call Center / BPO:
   - Francophone: 4,500 - 6,500 MAD | Anglophone: 6,000 - 9,500 MAD
4. Industry / Admin / Logistics:
   - Junior: 4,000 - 6,500 MAD | Senior: 8,000 - 14,000 MAD

### CRITICAL INSTRUCTION:
Output strictly valid JSON with NO markdown formatting, NO code fences, and NO explanations:
{
  "estimated_salary_mad": 14500,
  "seniority_level": "Mid",
  "workplace_type": "Hybrid",
  "top_skills": ["Python", "SQL", "Docker"]
}
